json_patch.value: Fix: Handle `TypeError` gracefully during docstring extraction. Target files: pydantic/_internal/_docs_extraction.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13870. Catching the error is fine, as `cloudpickle` later restores the docstring (and actually the whole `FieldInfo` instances) directly from the pickled data. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13874)
